args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em, 4 players. Core rules:
1. Play tight-aggressive. Strong starters (pairs, AK/AQ, suited broadways) raise for value, especially in late position.
2. Weak hands (low unsuited, disconnected junk) fold to any raise, especially out of position.
3. Bet/raise strong made hands and strong draws; avoid calling multiple bets with marginal hands.
4. Check-call medium hands in position; don't bluff into multiple opponents.
5. Respect big raises from tight players; reraise only with near-nuts.
6. Track opponents' tendencies (who bluffs, who folds to pressure) and adjust.
7. Pot odds: call when equity exceeds cost-to-call share of final pot.

Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight from early position; open with strong hands (pairs 77+, AK, AQ, AJs, KQs). Widen to suited connectors and broadways in late position (button, cutoff).
2. Fold weak unpaired hands facing a raise out of position.
3. Bet/raise strong made hands and good draws for value; in fixed limit, aggression usually beats passive calling.

5. Don't bluff into multiple opponents; bluff semi-bluff only heads-up with good equity.
6. Track opponents: note who raises wide, who folds to pressure, who calls everything. Adjust exploitatively.
7. Use retro notes after each game to refine these rules.
